note: Graded-reader levels (BRIEF_V2 §6.4, DECISIONS D-201/D-202). A word counts as in level when (a) the JLPT tags in dictionary.sqlite put it at this level or easier (jlpt; N6 'level 0' uses the N5 list), or (b) it has no JLPT tag and is within the first freqOrd words of the frequency list (freq_word; the tags miss basics such as 母 and りんご), or (c) commonCounts: it has no tag and is JMdict-common (N2, N1), or (d) openVocabulary: any word the dictionary resolves (N1), or (e) it is in the story's glossed vocabulary list. Names, numbers, particles, auxiliaries, interjections, prefixes, suffixes and 非自立 grammar words don't count either way. appJlpt: the level number the app uses (6 = level 0). chars: non-whitespace characters. textScore: allowed §6.4 text score, inclusive (tools reimplementation of app.tsumugi.coverage.DifficultyScorer). sentence: target mean Japanese characters per sentence, advice for authors (the score enforces it). questions: allowed number of comprehension questions. questionLanguage: stems and choices. skimCpm: characters per minute for the skim/scan timer. speed: VOICEVOX speedScale for the read-along audio. summary: target length of the post-reading summary in characters.
